defects.description: The above-maximum branch returns the unclamped value instead of max, so any value greater than max passes through unbounded.
defects.why_missed: The only test named for the above-maximum case asserts that the result is a number, a property every numeric return satisfies, so the suite stays green whether or not the value was actually clamped; the boundary reads as covered by its test name.
defects.severity_rationale: An above-maximum supported value is returned unclamped, silently giving callers a wrong result.

detection_criteria.mechanism: The above-maximum branch returns the unclamped value instead of max, so any value greater than max passes through unbounded.
detection_criteria.proof: Show one input or state where the output contradicts expected_behavior.
